verdict.rationale: Zapier's Platform CLI docs say integrations can be built with webhooks alongside polling triggers. A community user also reports that implementing a webhook with Zapier was easy. However, this evidence is about building integrations or one-off use, not a documented event-subscription mechanism for AI-native users. Missing for 10: documented webhook subscription API or endpoint for events, list of subscribable event types, delivery and retry and signature semantics, agent- or MCP-facing event subscription, hands-on corroboration.
